text:
sam: Heads-up — perf alert from ci:ci/perf/throughput-e2e, tokens/sec down ~32% on x86-gpu runners after last release. Attached flame: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/flame/run349.svg
ci-bot: perf test failed: throughput drop exceeded threshold (−31%). job: ci/perf/throughput-e2e #349
perf-bot: sample profiler (canary) top lines:
```
tokens/sec  baseline=1100 -> current=750  (-31%)
kernel selection: fallback to kernel=int8-generic from int8-avx512
scheduler: avg queue wait 12ms -> 68ms
batch size median 16 -> 6
kv cache hit rate 0.92 -> 0.81
```
matt: that kernel fallback is suspicious — we changed kernel-selector scoring in a1f3b9c (last merge). @lia do you recall any fallback heuristics changes?
lia: yeah, i touched the selector. I added "prefer_compatible_if_latency_unmet" but i think the math inverted for short sequences. i'll bisect now.
anya: can we pause canary rollout?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout halted for release/2026-03-16 due to perf regression.
sam: bisect result: commit a1f3b9c changed batch estimator + kernel-selector. quick check:
```
git bisect start HEAD v2026-03-10
git bisect bad
git bisect good v2026-03-10
# result: a1f3b9c  kernel: prefer_compat flag
```
lia: confirmed locally with microbench:
- baseline model: llm-redwood/opt-13b-8bit
- seq len 64, concurrency 12
- before: 1050 tok/s; after: 730 tok/s; queue wait spiked from 10ms->72ms
matt: kv cache impact — observed increased misses when kernel switched because kv-serialization path differed (miss key prefix). maybe intermediate patch altered KV key normalization.
sam: action items:
1) revert a1f3b9c (temporary) to un-block rollout: `git revert --no-commit a1f3b9c && run ci/perf/throughput-e2e`
2) add unit for kernel-selector with short seq preference + integration perf guard
3) fix kv key normalization (lia)
lia: working on a fix + test. will open PR with patch + perf CI run in ~2h.
ci-bot: queued run ci/perf/throughput-e2e #350 (triggered by revert PR)
matt: also adjust continuous-batcher to prefer fill-rate not hold-time for latency-sensitive tiers — current min_hold_ms was increased inadvertently in 7b4e2f0.
sam: noted. let's not change scheduler policy mid-rollout.
anya: :+1: @deploy-bot please resume canary when CI green.
deploy-bot: will resume canary after manual approval + all perf checks pass.
lia: PR opened: PR#4275 revert+fix, contains:
- revert a1f3b9c
- normalize KV keys in kv/cache.go
- add e2e perf guard for seq64 concurrency12
link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4275
sam: thanks. keep updates short — this thread will be the rollback coordination.
matt: FYI I attached perf artifacts to PR: /artifacts/perf/2026-03-16/run349.zip
perf-bot: regression alert cleared on branch revert-4275 once throughput within 3% of baseline.
lia: merging after CI green.
sam: merging now, rolling back canary in 10m if no regressions. :lock:
